name: content-copywriting
description: Write clear product copy, onboarding, interface microcopy, help text, and documentation for digital products.
---
# Product copywriting
- Write for the user's task and level of familiarity; prefer plain, specific language.
- Use consistent product terminology across navigation, buttons, forms, and help content.
- Make labels action-oriented and error messages explain what happened and how to recover.
- Avoid exaggerated claims, fake metrics, misleading guarantees, and unnecessary jargon.
- Keep UI copy concise; provide context for sensitive permissions and personal-data handling.
